# double-meh

> A modern, fetch-native HTTP I/O library for browsers and CLIs (Node, Bun, Deno) — a thin, DX-first layer over `fetch()`. Spend the effort on setup (inspectors, services, defaults) so that use stays trivial. The method declares the return shape; options tune behavior, never shape. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM-only, source published as-is with no build step, hand-written `.d.ts` sidecars.

## Quick start

Install:

```bash
npm i double-meh
```

```js
import io from 'double-meh';

const person = await io.get('https://api.example.com/people/42');
const created = await io.post('https://api.example.com/people', {name: 'Ann'});
```

## Importing

ESM-only. The `exports` map is `{".": "./src/index.js", "./*": "./src/*"}` — a non-transforming
wildcard, so every subpath import carries the `.js` extension.

```js
// The shared, fully configured instance
import io from 'double-meh';

// Named exports — all-named form when pulling several from one module
import {get, full, stream, update, adopt, create, IOError, BadStatus} from 'double-meh';

// Minimal build — bare pipeline plus only the services you want
import {createIO} from 'double-meh/io.js';
import {fetchTransport} from 'double-meh/transports/fetch.js';
import {installCache} from 'double-meh/services/cache.js';

// Persistent cache backends — opt-in, swapped via io.cache.storage
import {fsStorage} from 'double-meh/storage/fs.js';
import {sqliteStorage} from 'double-meh/storage/sqlite.js';
import {cacheApiStorage} from 'double-meh/storage/cache-api.js';

// CLI compression encoders (br/zstd) — opt-in, registered into io.encoders
import {installZlibEncoders} from 'double-meh/encoders/zlib.js';

// Service-Worker integration (page half) — pairs with the double-meh-sw sibling
import {installSW, installChannel} from 'double-meh/sw.js';
```

CJS consumers can `require('double-meh')` on Node >= 20.19 (`require(esm)`). Every default export
has a named mirror, so destructuring works:

```js
const {io, get, full, BadStatus} = require('double-meh');
```

That path stays open only because the module graph carries no top-level await — `require(ESM)` of an
async graph throws `ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE`. `tests/cli/test-cjs.cjs` pins it.

## The pipeline

```
verb sugar -> buildOptions -> prepare (headers/body/url) -> request inspectors
  -> track (run-level dedup) -> services onion (cache -> retry -> mock) -> transport
  -> decode -> envelope -> response inspectors
```

Instances: the default export is one shared configured instance; `io.create()` gives an isolated
equivalent with the same batteries; `createIO()` from `double-meh/io.js` gives a bare pipeline with
no services attached.

## Verbs

`io` is itself callable — `io(target, data?, options?)`. It carries `get`, `head`, `post`, `put`,
`patch`, `delete` (aliases `del` and `remove`), and `options`.

- `Verb` — `<T>(url: Target, data?: unknown, options?: Overrides) => Promise<T>`
- `MetaVerb` (`head`, `options`) — returns `Promise<Envelope>`
- `Target` — `string | URL | Options`; an options bag acts as a reusable endpoint descriptor
- `Overrides` — `Omit<Options, 'url'> & {url?: never}`

```js
await io.get(url);
await io.post(url, {name: 'Ann'}); // objects go out as JSON
await io.patch(url, {email}, {as: 'merge-patch'});
await io.del(url);

const people = {url: 'https://api.example.com/people', timeout: 5000}; // endpoint descriptor
await io.get(people);
await io.post(people, {name: 'Bo'});
```

## Return-shape namespaces

The namespace chooses the shape. No option changes it.

- `io.get(url)` -> `Promise<T>` — parsed data.
- `io.full` — `FullNamespace`, callable and carrying every verb; each returns `Promise<Envelope<T>>`.
- `io.stream.get(url, data?, options?)` -> `Promise<ReadableStream>`.
- `io.stream.put/post/patch(url, options?)` -> `StreamDuplex` = `{readable, writable, response}`, where `response` is a `Promise<Envelope<T>>` that settles when status and headers arrive, before the body drains.
- `io.records.get/post(url, data?, options?)` -> `AsyncIterableIterator<T>`; `RecordsOverrides` adds `framing?: 'jsonl' | 'json-seq'`.
- `io.sse(url, data?, options?)` -> `AsyncIterableIterator<SseEvent>`; `SseOverrides` adds `reconnect?: boolean | number` and `lastEventId?: string`. `io.sse.reconnectDelay` is the module-level default.

```js
const body = await io.stream.get(url);

const {writable, readable, response} = io.stream.put(url, {as: 'jsonl'});
source.pipeTo(writable);
const envelope = await response;

for await (const row of io.records.get(url, null, {framing: 'jsonl'})) use(row);
for await (const event of io.sse(url)) console.log(event.event, event.data);
```

## Envelope

```ts
interface Envelope<T = unknown> {
  data: T;
  status: number;
  ok: boolean;
  response: Response;
  headers: HeaderDict;
  readonly etag: string | undefined;
  readonly weak: boolean;
  readonly lastModified: Date | undefined;
  readonly location: string | undefined;
  readonly links: Record<string, string>;      // parsed Link header
  readonly contentType: string | undefined;
  readonly retryAfter: number | Date | undefined;
  readonly serverTiming: ServerTimingMetric[];  // {name, dur?, desc?}
}
```

The lazy accessors parse on first read. A thrown `BadStatus` carries the same shape.

## Options

```ts
interface Options {
  url: string | URL;
  method?: Method;                       // 'GET' | 'HEAD' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' | 'OPTIONS' | string
  query?: QueryInput;                    // Record | URLSearchParams | string | number | boolean
  listSeparator?: string | null;
  data?: unknown;
  headers?: HeaderDict | Headers;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  timeout?: number;
  transport?: string;
  fetch?: Omit<RequestInit, 'method' | 'headers' | 'body' | 'signal'>;
  accept?: string;
  as?: 'merge-patch' | 'json-patch' | 'json' | 'ndjson' | 'jsonl' | 'text' | 'csv' | 'html' | 'xml' | 'form' | 'octet' | string;
  decode?: DecodeMode | ((response: Response, options: Options) => unknown);
  ifMatch?: string;
  ifNoneMatch?: string;
  fields?: string[];
  sort?: string[];
  expand?: string[];
  page?: {offset?: number; limit?: number; cursor?: string};
  stream?: boolean;
  bust?: boolean | string;
  ignoreBadStatus?: boolean;
  cache?: boolean | {ttl?: number};
  track?: boolean | 'wait';
  mock?: boolean;
  retry?: boolean | number | RetryConfig;
  compress?: boolean | 'gzip' | 'deflate' | 'br' | 'zstd' | string | CompressionEncoder;
  bundle?: boolean | string;
  idempotencyKey?: boolean | string;
  force?: boolean;
  onDownloadProgress?(info: Progress): void;
  onUploadProgress?(info: Progress): void;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

Semantics worth knowing:

- **`listSeparator`** — how arrays serialize in the query. A string joins each list into one parameter (`','` -> `?tags=a,b`; note `URLSearchParams` percent-encodes the separator on the wire). `null` or unset -> repeated keys (`?tags=a&tags=b`), the ambiguity-free default. An explicit value also governs `fields`/`sort`/`expand`, whose own unset default stays `','` (their protocol form).
- **`decode`** — `DecodeMode` is `'json' | 'text' | 'blob' | 'arrayBuffer' | 'formData'`. A `decode` override opts the request out of `track` (the cache is byte-level and unaffected).
- **`retry`** — `RetryConfig` is `{retries?, initDelay?, force?, nextDelay?(delay, attempt, options), continueRetries?(response, attempt, options)}`. `continueRetries` turns retry into polling. Unsafe verbs are not retried without `force`.
- **`compress`** — an encoder name from `io.encoders`, `true` for gzip, or an inline `CompressionEncoder` (which owns its own `Content-Encoding` header — set it via `headers`).
- **`bundle`** — `true` joins the default window; a string names a bundle for `io.bundle.flush(name)`.
- **`idempotencyKey`** — `true` mints one key per logical operation and reuses it across retries; a string supplies your own.
- **`onUploadProgress`** — stream bodies meter per chunk (`lengthComputable: false`); a buffered body gets one completion event when the response arrives, because `fetch` exposes no granular upload progress for buffered sends. Bodies whose final encoding the platform owns (`FormData`, `URLSearchParams`) report nothing.
- **`Progress`** — `{loaded, total, lengthComputable}`.

## Helpers

- `io.update<T>(target, fn, options?)` -> `Promise<T>` — read, apply `fn`, conditional PUT; a 412 re-reads and retries. `UpdateFn<T>` may return `undefined` to abort the write.
- `io.paginate<T>(url, data?, options?)` -> `AsyncIterableIterator<T>` — iterates rows across pages.
- `io.getByIds<T>(url, ids, options?)` -> `Promise<T>` — built GETs longer than `io.getByIds.urlLimit` (default 2000) fall back to a POST body.
- `io.adopt(target, responseOrPromise)` -> `Promise<Envelope>` — adopt an in-flight or completed `Response` into the pipeline.
- `io.run<T>(target)` -> `Promise<Envelope<T>>` — the raw pipeline run, bypassing option defaults.
- `io.toEnvelope(response, target)` -> `Promise<Envelope>`.
- `io.makeKey(options)` / `io.buildUrl(options)` / `io.makeVerb(method)`.
- `io.inFlight` — count of live requests.

## Services

Response-level middleware in a priority onion. Each service opts in per request (its own option
wins) or by `theDefault`, a `boolean | ((options: Options) => boolean)`. Cache and track are on by
default for plain GETs. All expose `attach()` / `detach()`.

### io.track — run-level GET dedup

Dedup at the decoded-envelope level (decode once, share the result), keyed by the canonical
`makeKey`; streams are skipped. `track: 'wait'` registers interest without firing. Cancellation is
refcounted: a caller's abort detaches only that caller, rejecting with its own error; the wire
aborts when the last waiter leaves, and a signalless caller pins it to completion.

`{active, theDefault, deferred, flyByKey(key), fly(options), isFlying(options), optIn(options)}`

### io.cache — app-governed cache

`{storage, defaultTtl, theDefault, isActive, optIn(options), remove(pattern), clear(), sweep(), save(target, response, ttl?), idle()}`

TTL plus 304 revalidation. Entries snapshot the request-header values named by the response `Vary`
(a mismatch is a miss; `Vary: *` is never stored). `CachePattern` is `string | RegExp | (key) => boolean`.
`cache.remove(exactUrl)` evicts all accept variants.

`CacheStorage` is `{get, set, delete, clear, keys}`; a `CacheEntry` is
`{status, statusText, headers, body, etag?, lastModified?, expiresAt, vary?}`.

Backends: `memoryStorage` (default, per instance), `fsStorage` (one file per entry in the OS cache
dir, atomic temp+rename), `sqliteStorage` (feature-detected `node:sqlite` / `bun:sqlite`, not Deno;
async factory), `cacheApiStorage` (browser Cache API, metadata as synthetic `x-io-*` headers).
`double-meh/storage/cache-dir.js` exports `osCacheDir` and `appCacheDir` (XDG, `~/Library/Caches`,
`%LOCALAPPDATA%`).

### io.retry — verb-safety-aware retry

`{retries, initDelay, maxDelay, nextDelay(delay, attempt, options?), isActive}`

### io.mock — serverless mocking

`io.mock(matcher, callback?)` registers a mock; it runs through the real pipeline, so a mocked 503
really gets retried. `MockMatcher` is `string | RegExp | ((request, ctx) => boolean)`.
`{exact, isActive, clear()}`

### io.bundle — request bundling

Batches GETs into one request to a bundler endpoint and unbundles by MIME.

`{url, waitTime, maxSize, minSize, maxWait, writeThrough, theDefault, isActive, optIn(options), register(config), flush(name?), submit(requests, opts?), fly(targets)}`

`BundlerConfig` is `{url, match?, waitTime?, maxSize?, minSize?, maxWait?}`. `writeThrough` also
writes unpacked parts into the Cache API — a cache name, or `true` for the shared SW tier.
`double-meh/services/bundle.js` also exports `REQUEST_MIME` and `BUNDLE_MIME`.

## Errors

```
IOError
├── FailedIO
│   └── TimedOut
└── BadStatus
```

`BadStatus` also implements `Envelope`, so `error.status`, `error.data`, `error.headers`, and the
lazy accessors are all there; `problem+json` arrives already parsed. `isAbort(error)` classifies
aborts across engines (they disagree on abort-listener vs promise-reaction settle order, so the
mapping is deterministic rather than order-dependent). `ignoreBadStatus: true` returns the envelope
instead of throwing.

```js
import io, {isAbort} from 'double-meh';

try {
  await io.get(url);
} catch (error) {
  if (isAbort(error)) return;
  if (error instanceof io.BadStatus) console.error(error.status, error.data?.detail);
}
```

## Option defaults

`io.defaults(bag)` or `io.defaults(match, bag)` registers scoped option defaults — the lowest merge
layer, applied in `assemble` before the endpoint descriptor and per-call options, so defaults shape
both the wire and the cache key. Matching bags accumulate in registration order (later wins); a bag
never carries `url`. Omit `match` for instance-global defaults. `io.run` stays raw.

```js
io.defaults(/^https:\/\/api\.example\.com/, {timeout: 5000, listSeparator: ','});
```

`io.optionDefaults` is the registered list.

## Extension points

- `io.registerTransport(name, transport)`, `io.transports`, `io.defaultTransport`. A `Transport` is `(request: PreparedRequest, ctx: RequestContext) => Promise<Response>`.
- `io.inspect.request(fn, match?)` / `io.inspect.response(fn, match?)` — URL-scoped; `InspectorMatch` is `string | RegExp | ((url: string) => boolean)`. A request inspector may return a replacement `PreparedRequest`; a response inspector may return a replacement `Envelope`.
- `io.registerData(processor)` — a `DataProcessor` is `{match(data, options), encode(data, headers, options)}`.
- `io.registerMime(processor)` — a `MimeProcessor` is `{match(contentType, response), decode(response, options)}`; it runs on success and error bodies alike.
- `io.attach(service)` / `io.detach(name)` — a `Service` is `{name, priority, handle(request, ctx, next)}`.
- `io.mimeTypes` — the extension-to-MIME map.
- Events via `io.on(event, fn)` / `off` / `emit`: `request`, `success`, `failure`, `retry`, `ready`, `sw`.

## Optional modules

### double-meh/encoders/zlib.js

`installZlibEncoders(io)` registers br/zstd (via `node:zlib`) into `io.encoders`; kept out of browser
bundles. Also exports `gzipEncoder`, `deflateEncoder`, `brotliEncoder`, `zstdEncoder`.
`CompressionEncoder` is `(source: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, options) => ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | Promise<...>`.

### double-meh/sw.js

Page half of the Service Worker contract, pairing with the `double-meh-sw` sibling. Exports
`installSW`, `installChannel`, `SHARED_CACHE`, `CHANNEL`.

- `io.sw` (after `installSW`) — `{library, supported, connected, contract, version, capabilities, hello()}`. The `io:hello` handshake is client-wins: a page running the library keeps ownership of its own bundling.
- `io.channel` (after `installChannel`) — `{name, active, close()}`. Cross-tab cache invalidation over a `BroadcastChannel`; wraps `io.cache.remove` so evictions fan out, and `close()` restores it.

### Code-forward

`installCodeForward(io)` (already applied to the default instance) adopts requests fired by a
`__doubleMeh` prelude in the page `<head>` — network work starts before the library finishes
loading, and the library picks those responses up rather than refetching.

## Common patterns

```js
// Conditional update: the whole read -> apply -> conditional PUT loop, 412 -> re-read -> retry
await io.update(url, person => ({...person, email}));

// Effectively-once POST
await io.post(url, order, {idempotencyKey: true, retry: true});

// Polling until a condition holds
await io.get(url, null, {retry: {continueRetries: response => response.status === 202}});

// Per-host configuration without touching call sites
io.defaults(/^https:\/\/api\.example\.com/, {timeout: 5000, accept: 'application/json'});

// Isolated instance for a second API
const other = io.create();
other.cache.storage = await sqliteStorage({name: 'other'});

// Prefetch now, consume later — 'wait' registers interest without firing
io.get(url); // fires
const data = await io.get(url, null, {track: 'wait'}); // joins the in-flight run

// Pattern invalidation
await io.cache.remove(/\/people\//);
```
